#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <functional>

class FastScanner {
private:
    std::istream& in;
    char buffer[1024];
    int ptr;
    int buflen;
    
    bool hasNextByte() {
        if (ptr < buflen) return true;
        ptr = 0;
        in.read(buffer, sizeof(buffer));
        buflen = in.gcount();
        return buflen > 0;
    }
    
    int readByte() {
        return hasNextByte() ? static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[ptr++]) : -1;
    }
    
    static bool isPrintableChar(int c) {
        return c > 32 || c < 0;
    }
    
    static bool isNumber(int c) {
        return c >= '0' && c <= '9';
    }

public:
    FastScanner(std::istream& input = std::cin) : in(input), ptr(0), buflen(0) {}
    
    bool hasNext() {
        while (hasNextByte() && !isPrintableChar(buffer[ptr])) ptr++;
        return hasNextByte();
    }
    
    std::string next() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw std::runtime_error("No such element");
        std::string sb;
        int b;
        while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isPrintableChar(b)) {
            sb += static_cast<char>(b);
        }
        return sb;
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw std::runtime_error("No such element");
        long long n = 0;
        int b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            n = 0;
            while (isNumber(b = readByte())) {
                n = n * 10 + '0' - b;
            }
            return n;
        } else if (!isNumber(b)) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Number format error");
        }
        do {
            n = n * 10 + b - '0';
        } while (isNumber(b = readByte()));
        return n;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw std::runtime_error("No such element");
        int n = 0;
        int b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            n = 0;
            while (isNumber(b = readByte())) {
                n = n * 10 + '0' - b;
            }
            return n;
        } else if (!isNumber(b)) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Number format error");
        }
        do {
            n = n * 10 + b - '0';
        } while (isNumber(b = readByte()));
        return n;
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return std::stod(next());
    }
};

class IntMath {
public:
    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        while (a != 0) {
            if ((b %= a) != 0) a %= b;
            else return a;
        }
        return b;
    }
    
    static long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        while (a != 0) {
            if ((b %= a) != 0) a %= b;
            else return a;
        }
        return b;
    }
    
    static long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }
    
    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        for (int mul = a; b > 0; b >>= 1, mul *= mul) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) ans *= mul;
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static int pow(int a, int b, int mod) {
        if (b < 0) b = b % (mod - 1) + mod - 1;
        long long ans = 1;
        for (long long mul = a; b > 0; b >>= 1, mul = mul * mul % mod) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) ans = ans * mul % mod;
        }
        return static_cast<int>(ans);
    }
    
    static int floorsqrt(long long n) {
        return static_cast<int>(std::sqrt(n + 0.1));
    }
    
    static int ceilsqrt(long long n) {
        return n <= 1 ? static_cast<int>(n) : static_cast<int>(std::sqrt(n - 0.1)) + 1;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    int n = fs.nextInt();
    long long k = fs.nextLong();
    const long long MOD = 998244353;
    
    std::vector<long long> fact(n + 1);
    std::vector<long long> inv(n + 1);
    
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    }
    
    inv[n] = IntMath::pow(static_cast<int>(fact[n]), MOD - 2, MOD);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) {
        inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;
    }
    
    auto comb = [&](int i, int j) -> long long {
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD;
    };
    
    if (k == 0) {
        std::cout << fact[n] << std::endl;
    } else if (k > n) {
        std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
    } else {
        int k2 = static_cast<int>(k);
        int k3 = n - k2;
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k3; ++i) {
            long long tmp = comb(k3, i) * IntMath::pow(i, n, MOD) % MOD;
            if (((k3 - i) & 1) == 0) {
                ans = (ans + tmp) % MOD;
            } else {
                ans = (ans - tmp + MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
        std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
